# nte-core component source and license

This independent CLI derives from NTE DPS Toolkit. LICENSE, NOTICE.md, LICENSING.md, THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md and licenses/ retain attribution and terms.

Source base: 9d8431426624358e23f1873a273010f65a81007d; working-tree build input SHA-256: aecbcc6e5fa3c541e957cb8a2be8364b0b40ec2b5d25bd22fcf1880bb365f36f. Release x64 CLI without desktop UI. The base alone does not reproduce this integration build.

Equipment busy rejections retain the existing retry domain. A valid unknown-outcome receipt fails only its request and preserves the shared session; it is never automatically replayed. Malformed receipts and mismatched frozen identities remain protocol errors. Ordinary-clone restart acknowledgement clears the old attempt. Settlements remain pending until the observed monster-spawn response establishes the next attempt boundary; timestamp-based reconciliation retains post-spawn hits regardless of hit/context delivery order. Missing spawn remains explicitly pending without a fixed timeout. Subsequent monster waves do not reset the attempt. Abyss handling remains separate. Verified serialized StageChange responses and Fight state-log callbacks feed the same half reducer. The summary switches immediately to the delivered phase while queued hits retain timestamp ordering. Each half creates its scope only on its first hit; saving before the lower first hit retains only the upper scope. The native_snapshot_inline_raw_v1 capability carries the exact rawRecords alongside formal inventory and character pages. Calc can maintain the same frozen evidence baseline in one page stream; independent diagnostic raw cursors remain available.

Native battle regressions, four focused Abyss stage tests and a private local evidence replay passed. The replay retained all damage and assigned both halves. Calc tests cover waiting display and saving one or two half snapshots. Calc scope replacement, waiting display and lifecycle checks passed. Direct and proxy exact-binary load, handshake and shutdown checks passed. Existing equipment bridge and lifecycle behavior is retained. Exact-binary game acceptance remains pending. No private source, internal input list, symbols or account data is included.
